title: Derived coinduction with its precomposition action
statement: Let $f:R\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and choose ordinary unbounded module derived categories $D(R)$ and $D(B)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define $C_f:D(R)\to D(B)$ to be the total right derived functor of ordinary coinduction $\operatorname{Hom}_R(B,-)$, with $B$-action $(b\cdot h)(b\prime)=h(b\prime b)$ and maps by postcomposition. Its construction uses K-injective representatives: for a representative $I$ of $K$, the coinduced complex has terms $\operatorname{Hom}_R(B,I^j)$ and differential induced by $I$. Thus it is $R\operatorname{Hom}_R(B,K)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] with its specified $B$-action. No flatness, finiteness or boundedness hypotheses are imposed.
